ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.curr_donation_type != :vep_block.curr_donation_type or
 :global.procedure_group != :vep_block.procedure_group 
 then
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05',
 :global.curr_donation_type||','||
 :global.procedure_group||','||
 ',','D',chk); 
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
IF :global.curr_donation_type = :vep_block.curr_donation_type and
 :global.procedure_group = :vep_block.procedure_group 
THEN
 null;
ELSE 
 if :vep_block.curr_donation_type is not null and
 :vep_block.procedure_group is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_elig_periods
 WHERE curr_donation_type = :vep_block.curr_donation_type and
 procedure_group = :vep_block.procedure_group ;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05',
 :vep_block.curr_donation_type||','||
 :vep_block.procedure_group||','||
 ',','U',chk); 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C05C05',
 :vep_block.curr_donation_type||','||
 :vep_block.procedure_group||','||
 ',','U',chk); 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item = 'CTRL_BLOCK.CURR_DONATION_TYPE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.curr_donation_type',action);
 end if;
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_curr_don',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_curr_don',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if;
END;
